scope: Implement and exercise native Flash-Next MTP MXFP4 QAT with full-vocabulary teacher supervision and Weights and Biases tracking.

model_implementation.transformers_surface: Transformers 5.18.0 has Qwen4Exp trunk classes but no MTP model and explicitly ignores mtp.* checkpoint tensors.
model_implementation.weights: All 31 mtp.* tensors plus shared token embedding and shared lm_head load exactly from the local BF16 checkpoint.
model_implementation.input_contract: Verifier residual row i of width 10240 plus token at i+1 at absolute RoPE position i; output predicts token at i+2 through the shared head.
model_implementation.chain_smoke: For source row 0/token 795, the student argmax is 6195, exactly the next sidecar input token; full-vocabulary cosine against teacher row 1 is 0.739159345626831.

compact_export.non_claim: The compact export is a training input, not a Strata runtime GGUF.

qat_trainer.objective: Teacher-probability cross-entropy 0.1 plus total variation 0.9 over all 248320 logits.
qat_trainer.qat: MXFP4 fake-quant with straight-through gradients on each selected effective LoRA weight.
qat_trainer.position_contract: The trainer passes source_position from every Strata pair to FlashNextMTP. At one-token sequence length the common Q/K rotation cancels, so this bank's metrics match the earlier zero-position run, but absolute positions are now explicit and correct for multi-row sequences.
qat_trainer.t4_recipe: Frozen float16 base, float32 LoRA masters, dynamic GradScaler, MXFP4 straight-through QAT.

attention_and_dependencies.target_path: The native MTP layer is full/QSA attention, not a GDN layer; its custom PyTorch path reuses Qwen4ExpTextAttention.
attention_and_dependencies.model_supported_backends: eager and SDPA only. Transformers Qwen4Exp declares FlashAttention-2 and FlexAttention unsupported for this architecture.
attention_and_dependencies.decision: Use eager or SDPA for this one-token-per-pair MTP training path. A custom FlexAttention integration is technically possible on T4 but adds compile cost with no benefit at sequence length one and is not model-level supported by Transformers.
dependencies_not_added: peft: the trainer owns a small float32 LoRA implementation
flash-attn: excluded on SM 7.5 and unsupported by Qwen4Exp
xformers: PyTorch mem-efficient SDPA is already available
Liger: no measured fused-loss bottleneck and no SM 7.5 pass
fla/causal-conv1d/kernels: unnecessary for MTP-only training because the MTP layer is full attention
